rubric.0: A current, evidenced failure or missing required control; status gap.
rubric.1: Intent/design is documented, implementation or execution is not established; status partial.
rubric.2: Control is implemented with limited/static evidence; required scenarios remain incomplete; status partial.
rubric.3: Relevant normal scenarios are verified, but adverse/recovery or adjacent checks remain incomplete; status partial. Execution-sensitive controls require a successful run.
rubric.4: All checkpoints applicable to this criterion are reviewed and supported, including adverse/recurrence evidence where relevant; status supported.
rubric.unverified: No defensible current score. Excluded from observed score, included in coverage denominator.
rubric.not_applicable: Evidence-backed scope exclusion. Excluded from scoring denominators and counted separately.

scorecard.weight_policy: Initial fixed policy: listed high-impact controls weight 3; other controls and boundary aspects weight 2. Not calibrated defect probabilities.
scorecard.interpretation: Scores describe reviewed evidence maturity, not failure probability or release authorization. Unknowns lower coverage; their zero contribution to the achievement lower bound is not a defect verdict.

limitations: Evidence hashes verify artifact identity, not truth or adequacy. Supported means a named reviewer attested to evidence for this scope/revision. Graph freshness and runtime behavior are not established by a graph export. Scores describe reviewed evidence maturity, not safety certification.
